questions.question: Were preprocessing steps (imputation, encoding, scaling, feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, calibration) fitted on training folds only, with no information from test/validation data used to fit them? Report whether the article explicitly limits fitting to training folds or leaves it ambiguous whether test data could have leaked into preprocessing.

Was the test or validation set used only for final evaluation, or was it also used for tuning, threshold selection, calibration, or model selection? Report any described reuse of held-out data for decisions other than the final reported performance.

Are the same patients (or the same patient contributing repeated records) kept mutually exclusive across train/validation/test splits? Report whether the article states patient-level splitting, or instead splits records randomly in a way that could place the same patient on both sides — noting that temporal or site splits are not necessarily mutually exclusive by patient.

Are predictor/feature values those actually available at the stated prediction time, rather than measurements recorded at a different clinical period or after the prediction point? Report whether the article distinguishes the predictor availability time point from the outcome ascertainment window, or uses post-prediction information.

Was the outcome determined without knowledge of predictor values or model predictions (avoiding incorporation bias), using a consistent definition and assessment method across all participants (PROBAST+AI Domain 3)? Report whether predictors were part of the outcome definition or whether clinicians/adjudicators had access to predictor/model information.

For prognostic or time-to-event prediction studies, were censoring, loss to follow-up, and competing events (e.g., death, transplant, modality transfer) appropriately accounted for rather than simply excluding censored or competing-event participants (PROBAST+AI Domain 4)? Report how follow-up completeness and competing risks were handled.

Did the study evaluate model calibration (calibration plot/curve, calibration slope, calibration-in-the-large/intercept, ICI, Brier score) in addition to discrimination, and report uncertainty intervals (PROBAST+AI Domain 4 & TRIPOD+AI)? Report which calibration and clinical utility (e.g., decision curve analysis) measures were assessed.

Did the evaluation report performance and calibration across relevant demographic or clinical subgroups/sites, and clearly distinguish zero-fit external validation from model updating or recalibration on target data (PROBAST+AI 2025 & FUTURE-AI)? Report whether target labels or covariates were used to update/recalibrate the model.
